title: Bouillotte

retourneNote.favori: The retourne completes a brelan favori! (your pair + the shared card make three).
retourneNote.carre: Your brelan matches the retourne's rank (carré) — a top-class hand!

bettingNotice: Your turn — call, raise (vie), or fold.

potOdds.free: No chips to call — you can stay in for free (check).

tutorial.info: This shows the round number, pot, ante, current bet, and each player's chips and status. Bouillotte is an 18th-century French 3-card poker-vying pot game played with three cards each plus a shared 'retourne' card.
tutorial.hand: Your three cards. A brelan (three cards of the same rank, counting the retourne) is the strongest hand; otherwise hands are compared by high card.
tutorial.actions: Call to match the current bet, raise (vie) to increase it, or fold to sit out the round. When betting ends the hands are compared to decide the pot.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game and start over.
